name: 29mvr-winning-strategy-v2
description: Multi-LLM winning-strategy flow for matter 29MVR: ingest → 3 parallel strategies (GPT/Claude/Gemini) → 2 adversarial red-teams → 3 validations → 3-member peer panel → consensus/audit/risk → formal dispatch. Faithful to services/deep-agent-service/configs/29mvr_flow_registry.json flow-29mvr-multi-llm-winning-strategy-v2-20node.

step.name: s1_evidence
step.prompt: Gather all evidence from the 29MVR case materials.

step.name: s1_extract
step.prompt: Extract the key legal facts from the gathered evidence {{s1_evidence}}.

step.name: s2_strategy_gpt
step.prompt: Generate the primary adjudication strategy from {{s1_extract}}.

step.name: s2_strategy_claude
step.prompt: Generate an independent adjudication strategy from {{s1_extract}}.

step.name: s2_strategy_gemini
step.prompt: Generate an independent adjudication strategy from {{s1_extract}}.

step.name: s3_redteam_deepseek
step.prompt: Red-team adversarial review of the strategies in {{strategies}}: find the strongest counter-arguments.

step.name: s3_redteam_kimi
step.prompt: Red-team cost and risk analysis of the strategies in {{strategies}}.

step.name: s4_financial
step.prompt: Financial validation of the red-teamed strategy in {{redteam}}.

step.name: s4_compliance
step.prompt: Regulatory and scheme compliance check of the strategy in {{redteam}}.

step.name: s4_creative
step.prompt: Creative settlement options based on {{redteam}}.

step.name: s5_review_1
step.prompt: Peer-review the validated strategy in {{validation}} (panel member 1).

step.name: s5_review_2
step.prompt: Peer-review the validated strategy in {{validation}} (panel member 2).

step.name: s5_review_3
step.prompt: Peer-review the validated strategy in {{validation}} (panel member 3).

step.name: s6_consensus
step.prompt: Cross-validate and build consensus over the peer reviews in {{peer-review}}.

step.name: s6_synthesis
step.prompt: Synthesize the final strategy document from the consensus in {{s6_consensus}}.

step.name: s6_audit
step.prompt: Run a consistency audit of the synthesis in {{s6_synthesis}}.

step.name: s6_risk
step.prompt: Final risk triage and human-in-the-loop preparation for {{s6_audit}}.

step.name: s7_notice
step.prompt: Generate the formal legal notices from the consensus in {{consensus}}.

step.name: s7_review
step.prompt: Review the notices for compliance and completeness.

step.name: s7_package
step.prompt: Compile the final delivery package.
